name: Lifeguard Training, Junior Lifeguarding and Junior Swim Instructor
what_you_do: You can take Red Cross lifeguard training. You can also take a junior lifeguard class. Or try Junior Swim Instructor, where you shadow instructors. This can lead to volunteer chances and city aquatics jobs.
who_can_apply: Lifeguard Training: you must turn 15 by the last day of the class. On day one you take a swim test. Swim 150 yards, tread water 2 minutes with only your legs, then swim 50 yards. You also bring up a 10 pound brick in a timed test. Junior Lifeguarding and Junior Swim Instructor are for 11 to 15 year olds. Junior Lifeguarding has a swim check on day one.
pay_detail: Summer 2026 fees: Lifeguard Training $275, Junior Lifeguard Training $185, Junior Swim Instructor $100. Check the current Rec Guide or online registration for new prices.
deadline_text: Courses are offered throughout the year. Check WebTrac for sessions.
how_to_apply: Register for a course through City of Davis online registration (the page links to it). Questions: 530-757-5626 or csweb@cityofdavis.org.
notes: These classes can lead to city pool jobs. Junior Swim Instructor is for teens who may want to work for Davis Aquatics later. You may get to volunteer after the class. The page does not promise a job. To get a lifeguard card, you must come to every class and pass the tests. City lifeguard jobs start at 15. Swim teacher jobs start at 15, or 14 if you did Junior Swim Instructor. That is from the 2026 job posts. See the City of Davis Seasonal Lifeguard and Swim Instructor Jobs card.
